title: Website Audit
tagline: Crawl a whole site, score it, prove each finding.
ability: Crawls a site, reads every screenshot including mobile, and scores it out of 100. Prospect mode hands you evidence for outreach; QA mode gives a ship or don't-ship verdict on a site you built.
flavor: A false "broken" claim in outreach kills credibility; a false pass in QA ships a bug.
